title: The King Who Forgave! 👑 The Unforgiving Servant | Bible Lesson for Kids | Sunday School
desc:
Imagine owing so much money that you could never pay it back! 😰 In this Sunday School lesson for kids, Jesus tells the Parable of the Unforgiving Servant: a kind king forgives a servant a HUGE debt of 10,000 bags of gold, but then that servant will not forgive his friend who owes him just 100 small coins. Then Elias learns how good it feels to be forgiven by Mommy, and forgives his little brother Nico too!

📖 Memory verse: "Forgive, and you will be forgiven." (Luke 6:37)
🎯 Lesson: Forgiveness, kindness and mercy. God forgives us every time we say sorry, so we forgive others too.
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.
